title: 6 ft Rope Dog Leash with Padded Handle and Reflective Line
bullets: 6-foot nylon leash gives your dog room to move while you keep hold of the handle.
360° swivel clasp attaches to a harness or collar and helps avoid tangles, per the maker.
Soft foam handle is padded to reduce friction and help you keep a comfortable grip, per the maker.
Embedded reflective line adds visibility on night walks, per the maker.
Open-design waste bag holder carries multiple bags. Waste bags are not included.
description: Walking your dog should feel simple. This 6-foot rope leash gives your dog room to move while you keep a firm hold. The maker lists it for medium and large dogs and describes the nylon as durable, wear-resistant, and lightweight. The leash is 1/2 inch wide and comes in black. A 360° swivel clasp attaches to a harness or collar and helps prevent tangles during your walk. The soft foam handle is padded to reduce friction in your hand, per the maker. A reflective line is embedded in the nylon to add visibility on night walks, though reflective material helps others see you and does not replace watching your dog. An open-design waste bag holder carries multiple bags so they are ready when you need them. Waste bags are not included. Before each walk, check the clasp and the handle stitching, and replace the leash if you see fraying.

faq.q: What size dog is this leash for?
faq.a: The maker lists this leash for medium and large dogs. It is 6 feet long and 1/2 inch wide. Check that the clasp fits your dog's harness or collar before you walk.

faq.q: Does it come with waste bags?
faq.a: No. The leash has an open-design waste bag holder that can carry multiple bags. Waste bags are not included.
